name: Write standardized concept and creative briefs
what: Extends the standard creative brief by turning a founder voice note, Slack message or intake form submission directly into the fixed-field brief, so nobody re-types a request by hand before the brief exists.
encompasses: Transcribe a founder voice note or Slack message and map it straight into the fixed brief fields
Parse a Notion or Airtable intake form submission into the same brief template automatically
Ask one clarifying question only when a required field cannot be filled from the source, never invent the missing fact
Queue an incomplete intake for the founder instead of guessing an angle or offer
inputs: founder voice note or Slack message
outputs: structured brief, auto-filled from raw intake
founder_sees: The brief built from what you said, ready to check before it goes further.

name: Build UGC and creator sourcing briefs
what: Extends creator sourcing by having the agent browse UGC and creator marketplaces itself, shortlist candidates against the brief's own vetting bar, and draft outreach, instead of a person scrolling profiles by hand.
encompasses: Browse marketplaces (Billo, Minisocial, JoinBrands) filtered by niche, follower count and past brand work; for an India-market brief, browse India platforms such as Kofluence and Winkl instead
Shortlist 5 to 10 candidates per brief against the vetting bar already set from past creator work
Draft the outreach and rate-negotiation message for each shortlisted creator, never send it without sign-off
Track response and acceptance rate per marketplace to learn which one sources faster for this brand
founder_sees: A shortlist of creators worth contacting, with a draft message for each.

name: Direct product photography and image accuracy
what: Extends photography direction with the full shoot logistics pack for a physical shoot, and a batch pass that generates and checks AI backgrounds across a whole SKU catalogue at once.
encompasses: Build the shot list, prop list, equipment checklist and location or studio note before a booked shoot
Draft the model release and usage-rights lines for anyone appearing on camera
Generate AI lifestyle backgrounds for the full SKU catalogue in one batch pass
Run a visual-diff check on the batch, flagging any generated image where the product itself drifted from the real photo
Estimate the shoot day budget from crew, location and equipment line items
outputs: batch background set with visual-diff flags
founder_sees: The shoot pack ready to hand to a photographer, or the full catalogue's new backgrounds with anything inaccurate flagged.

name: Run claim, policy and compliance checks
what: Extends the claim and compliance check with a platform-specific ad policy pre-flight pass, since Meta, TikTok, Google and each marketplace restrict different categories and wording beyond the brand's own claim tiers.
encompasses: Check restricted content categories (health, finance, before-after imagery, personal attributes) against the specific platform this ad will run on
Check image text and overlay rules for the destination platform before the file is finalized
Check marketplace ad policy (Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus; Flipkart for an India-market brand, markets: IN) separately from social platform policy, since the rule sets differ
Re-run the check whenever a platform updates its policy, not only at first ship
trigger: event: before every set ships to a specific platform
founder_sees: Which platform-specific rule, if any, this set would trip before it ships there.

name: Break down and analyze own ad winners and losers
what: Extends winner/loser analysis with an automated performance report deck and shareable mood board, so a batch's results reach the founder and any outside collaborator as a visual page, not a raw metrics table.
encompasses: Auto-build a report deck comparing this batch's winning and losing themes with example thumbnails
Build a shareable mood board of the batch's images for reference, an outside creator or the founder
Compare this batch against the account's own past winning themes, not an industry average
founder_sees: A short deck of what won and lost this batch, with the images, not just numbers.

name: Design and structure creative and copy tests
what: Extends test design with live threshold monitoring that pushes a founder alert the moment a running test crosses its pre-set kill, scale or refresh rule, and adds thumbnail or first-frame testing for video ads.
encompasses: Poll a running test against its pre-set winner, kill and read-window rules on a fixed schedule
Push one alert the moment a threshold is crossed, never wait for the next scheduled report
Test 2 to 3 thumbnail or first-frame options per video ad separately from the body-copy test
Silence repeat alerts on the same ad once the founder has acted on the first one
founder_sees: An alert the moment a test result is ready to act on, instead of finding out days later.

name: Plan and monitor the creative production pipeline and portfolio
what: Extends the monthly pipeline plan with a reserved experimental lane, a fixed small share of monthly creative slots for high-risk concepts, tracked separately so one swing does not get killed by the same average-performance rule as the safe majority.
encompasses: Reserve a fixed share (for example 1 in 10 slots) of the monthly plan for a high-risk, high-upside concept
Track the experimental lane's hit rate separately from the core pipeline's hit rate
Extend an experimental concept's read window since a genuine swing needs more data before judgment
outputs: experimental lane allocation and separate hit-rate tracking
founder_sees: How much of this month's budget is the safe bet versus the swing, and how each is doing.

name: Maintain naming, tagging and platform-spec standards
what: Extends the naming and tagging standard with computer-vision auto-tagging: the agent looks at an uploaded file itself and fills the tag fields (UGC or product shot, format, aspect ratio, approximate video length) instead of a person tagging each asset by hand.
encompasses: Detect content style (UGC vs product photography vs founder-led) from the file itself
Detect aspect ratio, resolution and, for video, duration automatically
Auto-apply the account's fixed naming schema in the right field order once detected
Flag a file the vision check cannot confidently classify for a human to tag instead of guessing
founder_sees: Nothing directly. Every new asset arrives already tagged and named.

name: Localise creative and copy for market and device
what: Extends localisation with AI dubbing and lip-sync: takes an already-winning video ad and produces a localized version in another language or dialect without a reshoot, for markets where a real local shoot is not yet justified.
encompasses: Dub the winning ad's voiceover into the target language, keeping the same delivery pace and hook timing
Lip-sync the dub to the speaker's mouth movements so it does not read as an obvious redub
Keep localized captions and on-screen text in sync with the new audio
Run every dubbed line through the claim check in the target language, since a translation can drift from the approved claim
trigger: event: winner identified for a new market
founder_sees: The same winning ad, speaking the new market's language, before it needs a real local shoot.

name: Research competitor creative and messaging, signal only
what: Extends competitor research with a standing multi-platform swipe file: auto-transcribes competitor video hooks into a searchable text library and adds a rough spend or reach estimate signal, so the weekly scan produces a growing asset instead of a one-off note.
encompasses: Save every reviewed competitor ad into a tagged, searchable swipe file across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, not only Meta
Auto-transcribe competitor video hooks into text for pattern search later
Attach a rough spend or reach estimate to each saved ad as a signal of scale, never as a performance claim
Track a named competitor's ad account continuously between the fixed weekly checks, flagging a sudden new format or angle
founder_sees: A growing library of competitor structure and hooks, tagged and searchable, marked as signal only.

name: Write video ad scripts and storyboards
what: Extends video scripting with a pacing check: verifies the script's word count and beat timing actually fit the target video length before it goes to production, catching an overwritten script before a shoot or edit wastes time on it.
encompasses: Count words against a spoken-words-per-second rate for the target length (15s, 30s, 60s)
Flag a script that runs long before it reaches storyboard stage
Check each script beat (hook, bridge, mechanism, proof, CTA) gets its planned share of the runtime, not just total length
founder_sees: Nothing directly. This catches an overwritten script before it wastes a shoot or edit.

name: Prepare bulk ad-launch upload sheets
what: Turns an approved batch of ad copy and creative filenames into the exact spreadsheet or CSV a bulk-upload tool or Ads Manager's own bulk editor expects, one row per ad, so a person only reviews and clicks launch.
encompasses: Map each creative file, headline, primary text and CTA to the platform's required CSV columns
Apply the account's fixed naming convention to every campaign, ad set and ad name in the sheet
Carry over only the budget, audience and placement values the media buyer already approved, never invent one
Flag any row missing a required field before the sheet is handed over
Produce a separate sheet per platform since Meta's bulk editor and TikTok's bulk tool use different columns
Version each sheet so a re-upload after edits does not create duplicate ads
inputs: media buyer's approved budget and audience plan
trigger: event: creative batch approved for launch
founder_sees: The exact sheet that will go into Ads Manager, ready to check before anyone clicks launch.

name: Generate synthetic AI-actor UGC video ads end to end
what: Turns a written script into a finished vertical video ad using a licensed AI actor who reads the hook to camera, without booking a human creator or a shoot, for early testing before real UGC is commissioned.
encompasses: Pick an AI actor whose look and delivery match the brief's persona, not a random default
Feed the actor the exact approved script line by line, never let the tool improvise a claim
Generate 3 to 5 hook variants of the same script for a cheap pre-test before commissioning a real creator
Add on-screen captions and a CTA card in the brand's own template
Run every generated line through the claim and compliance check before it is used
Label every synthetic-actor ad as such in the internal tagging system, never pass it off as real UGC to the founder
Reserve real human UGC for anything a synthetic actor cannot say honestly, such as a real before-after story
outputs: finished vertical video ad, several hook variants
founder_sees: The generated video, clearly marked as an AI actor, before it enters testing.

name: Generate ad variants directly from a product page URL
what: Reads a live product page, pulls its images, price and stated claims, and drafts a first-pass set of static and video ad variants from it, as a fast starting point the strategist edits rather than a blank page.
encompasses: Pull product images, price, variants and stated specs from the page, never invent a spec not on the page
Draft 3 to 6 ad concepts (different hooks, same product facts) from the page content
Flag any page claim that is not already tiered in the brand record, for the compliance check to resolve
Match the drafted CTA to the page's actual buy button and current offer, not a stale one
Re-draft automatically if the source page's price or stock status changes before launch
outputs: first-pass ad concept set (static and video)
source-page fact list with URL and date
founder_sees: A first draft built straight from the live product page, ready to edit.

name: Manage creator whitelisting and Partnership/Spark Ads authorization
what: Runs the technical steps that turn a creator's organic post into a paid whitelisted or Spark ad, checks the prerequisites first, and tracks every authorization code and its expiry.
encompasses: Check the creator's Instagram is linked to a Facebook Page before requesting Partnership Ads access, the most common blocker
Walk the creator through generating the 8-digit TikTok Spark Ads code or Meta Partnership Ads authorization
Log each code with the post it belongs to, the date issued and the date it expires
Confirm the authorized post matches the exact creative and copy the brief approved, not a different cut
Flag a code nearing expiry so the ad can be relaunched before it drops
Keep whitelisting requests to pages that already post well organically, never a dead account
inputs: creator brief and usage rights log
trigger: event: creator content approved for paid use

external_write.surface: Meta Partnership Ads authorization; TikTok Spark Ads code exchange

founder_sees: Which creators are ready to whitelist, which are blocked and why, and when each code expires.

name: Auto-resize and reformat one master creative into every placement spec
what: Takes one approved master creative and produces every aspect-ratio and placement version a platform needs, feed square, story vertical, in-stream widescreen, recomposing the focal point rather than stretching or cropping blind.
encompasses: Recompose the safe zone and focal point per aspect ratio, never a blind crop that cuts off the product or CTA
Produce the fixed set: 1x1, 4x5, 9x16 and 16x9 from one master file
Re-time text and caption cards to fit the shorter frame of a 9x16 cut
Check every resized version keeps the CTA and price fully visible, not clipped by platform UI overlays
Flag a master creative whose composition cannot be safely resized, so it gets reshot for that placement instead of stretched
outputs: full placement set of resized creative
founder_sees: One approved creative, already delivered in every size a platform will ask for.

name: Generate captions, burned-in subtitles and alt text for every ad asset
what: Adds accurate burned-in captions to every video ad, since most are watched muted, and writes descriptive alt text for every static image, as a fixed QA step before anything ships.
encompasses: Transcribe the finished voiceover or on-screen speech and burn in captions matched to the brand's caption style
Time captions to the cut, never let a line run past its shot
Write alt text for every static and carousel image describing the product and offer, not just the file name
Check caption wording against the claim rules since a caption is still a claim
Support at least one non-English caption set where the localisation spec calls for it
founder_sees: Nothing directly. This is a fixed QA step before an ad ships.

name: Auto-cut one master video ad into multiple length and aspect-ratio derivatives
what: Cuts one finished long-form video ad into a family of shorter derivatives, a 15-second and a 6-second bumper cut, each keyed to a different hook from the hook bank, without a fresh edit session per cut.
encompasses: Cut to the strongest hook variant already tested in the hook bank, not an arbitrary trim
Keep the proof and CTA beat in every derivative even at 6 seconds
Produce a story-style vertical cutdown and a feed-style square cutdown from the same source
Re-time captions to each new cut length
Tag each derivative back to its parent video and the hook it uses, for the winner teardown to trace later
outputs: set of length and aspect-ratio derivatives, each tagged to its parent
founder_sees: The same winning video, already cut into the short lengths a platform actually rewards.

name: Score new creative for predicted performance before spend
what: Runs a draft creative through a predictive scoring pass before it enters a paid test, flagging weak elements (hook clarity, headline-image mismatch, CTA visibility) so a likely loser is fixed or dropped before it spends real budget.
encompasses: Score a draft's visual and copy elements against patterns from the account's own past winners and losers, not a generic industry model alone
Flag a specific weak element (hook, image-text mismatch, buried CTA), never just a single opaque score
Rank a batch of drafts so the weakest gets fixed or cut before it enters the test budget
Treat the score as a filter before spend, never as the final word after real results exist
outputs: pre-launch score per draft, with flagged weak elements
trigger: event: before a new batch enters paid testing
founder_sees: Which drafts in this batch are likely weak, and why, before any of them spend money.

name: Generate catalogue-scale ad variant grids from the product feed
what: Combines a fixed template, the product feed's price and image fields, and a small set of copy blocks to produce a full grid of ad variants across hundreds of SKUs at once, instead of building each SKU's ad by hand.
encompasses: Read price, image, title and stock fields straight from the product feed, never a stale copy
Apply a fixed set of template x headline x CTA combinations across every SKU in the grid
Skip a SKU with a missing image or price rather than publish a broken variant
Cap grid size to what the account's own testing budget can actually read
Regenerate only the SKUs whose feed data changed, not the whole grid, on a refresh
trigger: event: new catalogue campaign, or on feed refresh
founder_sees: How many SKUs got a ready ad variant this run, and which ones were skipped and why.

name: Write and design payment and delivery reassurance creative messaging
what: Writes the ad and post-purchase creative lines that build trust in how an order gets paid for and delivered: free returns, BNPL options, and a real delivery date. Includes, as the India-market option, the lines that push a cash-on-delivery order toward prepaid and the delivery-trust messaging that lowers return-to-origin risk; that option reads null for a US brand.
encompasses: Write payment-flexibility lines (card, Shop Pay, PayPal, Apple Pay, BNPL such as Affirm, Klarna or Afterpay) framed as removing friction, never as pressure
Write free-returns and real-delivery-date lines that reduce checkout hesitation
Write the SMS (TCPA consent, quiet hours) or email follow-up message offering an incentive or reminder inside a short window after checkout

India-market option (markets: IN, null for a US brand): write the prepaid-incentive line (small discount or free shipping) framed as unlocking a benefit, never as a penalty for choosing COD, the WhatsApp or SMS follow-up with a payment link after a COD order, and the delivery-trust lines (real dispatch time, real carrier, easy return) that lower return-to-origin risk
Check every reassurance, incentive or COD/RTO claim (discount amount, delivery time, BNPL terms) against the brand record before it ships
inputs: brand brain: shipping and payment policies
order data (warehouse); COD and RTO data where the brand runs COD (markets: IN)
outputs: payment and delivery reassurance ad and message copy
COD-to-prepaid ad copy and RTO-reduction creative lines (markets: IN)
founder_sees: The exact lines that build payment and delivery trust before checkout, and, for a COD brand, the numbers behind a prepaid nudge checked against your policy.

name: Build Amazon A+ Content and Walmart/Target Plus brand-store creative modules
what: Designs the banner, infographic and comparison-chart modules for a marketplace's own A+ Content or brand-store template grid, since these follow a fixed module system unlike a normal ad canvas.
encompasses: Design each module (hero banner, feature comparison, lifestyle image, spec table) to the marketplace's exact pixel and module-count limits
Reuse the brand's approved claims and real product photos, never a new unchecked claim written just for this module

Build a separate module set per marketplace (Amazon A+, Walmart Marketplace brand shop, Target Plus; Flipkart brand store and Myntra brand page for an India-market brand, markets: IN) since their templates differ
Flag a module that would look identical to the standard listing images, since A+ content should add new information, not repeat it
inputs: marketplace's current template grid and size limits
outputs: A+ Content or brand-store module set, per marketplace
founder_sees: The finished module set, ready to upload to the marketplace's own content manager.

name: Clone a consenting voice for scaled ad voiceover variants
what: Clones the founder's or a contracted creator's own voice, with their documented written consent, to produce many voiceover script variants without booking a new recording session for every script change.
encompasses: Require documented written consent naming voice cloning, commercial use and every channel the audio will run on, before any clone is made
Generate the voiceover for each approved script variant from the cloned voice, never let the voice model improvise a line
Re-generate a voiceover in minutes when a script edit changes only a few words, instead of a new studio session
Retire and delete a cloned voice the moment the person's consent window ends
inputs: consenting person's voice sample and signed consent
trigger: on demand, only after consent is on file
founder_sees: The consent on file and the generated voiceover, before any script variant using it goes further.

name: Build and maintain a consistent AI character or mascot sheet for reuse
what: Builds a fixed reference sheet for a generated character or mascot, expressions, angles, outfit, so every later AI-generated image or video reuses the same identity instead of a new random face each time.
encompasses: Generate a character sheet: front, side and three-quarter views, a few expressions, in the brand's chosen style
Reference the same sheet on every later generation so the character does not visibly drift between assets
Version the sheet if the brand deliberately updates the character's look, and retire the old version everywhere at once
founder_sees: The reference sheet, so any future generated asset can be checked against the same character.

name: Operate a browser agent to draft-upload creatives into Ads Manager as paused drafts
what: Drives Meta or TikTok Ads Manager's own web interface to create a paused, unpublished draft ad per approved creative, so a human reviews a real draft inside the platform instead of a spreadsheet, without spending a dollar until they hit publish.
encompasses: Navigate Ads Manager's ad-creation flow and fill in creative, copy and destination fields from the approved set
Leave every draft paused and unpublished, never toggle it live
Screenshot the finished draft as it will actually render for the reviewer to check
Stop and flag if the platform's UI has changed in a way the agent cannot navigate reliably, rather than guess
outputs: paused draft ads inside Ads Manager
trigger: event: creative batch approved for launch

external_write.surface: Meta Ads Manager / TikTok Ads Manager draft (paused) ad creation

founder_sees: The draft ad exactly as it will render in Ads Manager, paused, waiting for a publish decision.

name: Clear stock footage, fonts and music rights used in video ads
what: Checks every piece of licensed stock footage, music and font used in a video ad against its actual license terms before the ad ships, so a takedown or claim never lands after spend is already behind it.
encompasses: Log the license type (royalty-free, one-time, subscription) and the exact usage scope for every stock clip and track used
Check the license covers paid advertising use, not only organic or editorial use, before the asset ships
Check a licensed font's commercial-ad terms separately from its general web-use terms
Flag any asset whose license window expires while the ad is still expected to run
Keep the license file attached to the finished ad's record, not only to the raw asset
inputs: stock footage, music and font licenses used in a video ad
outputs: rights clearance checklist per video ad
trigger: event: before a video ad using licensed assets ships
founder_sees: Nothing directly, unless a license does not cover paid use, in which case it is flagged before the ad ships.

name: Build a holiday and sale-event creative production calendar with lead-time countdowns
what: Builds the year's creative production calendar around the US holiday calendar and the account's own sale events, each with a working-backward countdown (concept, build, review, launch) so a holiday batch is never rushed the week of. For an India-market brand, runs the same countdown off the India festive calendar instead (markets: IN, null for a US brand).
encompasses: List the year's relevant US holiday and sale dates (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Prime Day, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, back to school, July 4, Q4 holiday season) the brand actually runs offers around
India-market option (markets: IN, null for a US brand): list the year's relevant Indian festivals (Diwali, Holi, Republic Day sale, Raksha Bandhan) instead of, or alongside, the US calendar
Work backward from each date to set concept, build, review and launch deadlines with real lead time
Flag when two holiday or festive windows overlap the same production slot, so volume gets planned, not doubled up last minute
Carry the prior year's same-event creative and its results forward as a starting reference, not a blank slate
inputs: brand brain: past sale events and results
US holiday calendar; India festive calendar for an India-market brand (markets: IN)
outputs: annual holiday and sale-event production calendar with lead-time countdowns
trigger: event: annual planning, or new sale event added
founder_sees: The year's creative calendar, with each holiday batch's real deadline worked backward from the date.

name: Scan organic social mentions and reviews video for paid-ad-worthy customer content
what: Scans a brand's own tags, mentions and review videos across social platforms for genuine customer content strong enough to become a paid ad, then requests usage rights, instead of relying only on commissioned UGC.
encompasses: Search the brand's tags, mentions and hashtag for organic customer posts and review videos
Screen out likely fake, paid or unrelated content before flagging anything as a candidate
Rank candidates by how clearly they show a real reaction or a real before-after moment
Draft the usage-rights request message to the customer for anything worth pursuing
outputs: ranked list of paid-ad-worthy organic content
founder_sees: Real customer content worth turning into an ad, with a draft message ready to ask permission.

name: Design catalogue and DPA overlay templates for the full product feed
what: Builds the actual price, discount and badge overlay template that renders correctly across every SKU in the product feed for dynamic and catalogue-retargeting ads, going beyond flagging a broken template to producing the working one.
encompasses: Design one overlay template per placement (feed, story) that pulls price, discount and stock fields straight from the feed
Test the template against the SKU with the longest title and highest price to catch truncation and overflow before launch
Auto-swap the badge (bestseller, low stock, new) from a rule set, never a manually typed one per SKU
Regenerate the rendered preview whenever the feed's price or stock field changes
Hand the finished template to the existing catalogue risk check for a final pass before it goes live
outputs: DPA overlay template set, rendered previews per placement
trigger: event: new catalogue or DPA campaign, or feed schema change
founder_sees: What the price and badge overlay will actually look like across the catalogue before it goes live.

name: Audit live ads against their landing destination for promise, image and offer match drift
what: Checks every currently live ad against the page it sends traffic to, and flags when the ad's image, price, offer or headline no longer matches what the page now shows, since pages get updated after an ad keeps running.
encompasses: Pull the current live ad's creative and copy alongside the current live version of its destination page
Compare price, offer, product image and headline claim between the two, flag any mismatch
Catch the common drift case: the site's price or offer changed after the ad launched and nobody paused it
Flag an ad sending to a now-broken or redirected URL
Rank flagged mismatches by ad spend, so the highest-spend drift gets fixed first
outputs: ad-to-page mismatch report, ranked by spend
founder_sees: Which live ads no longer match their own landing page, ranked by how much money is behind each one.

name: Track actual production cost per asset against the monthly creative budget
what: Logs the real cost of every asset produced, AI generation credits, freelancer or agency invoices, stock license fees, against the monthly plan's budget line, so cost per ad is a real number instead of an assumption.
encompasses: Log AI tool spend, freelancer and agency invoices and stock license fees per asset
Compare actual cost per asset type (static, UGC video, AI-generated video) against the plan's assumed cost
Flag when a concept's real cost is running over its planned share before the month closes
Feed the real cost-per-ad number back into format economics instead of an assumed one
founder_sees: What creative actually cost this month, by format, against what was planned.
